## Ipnut specifications for functions and parameters

### Functions 

Functions are defined as rows in a Function table, with potential columns 

  * fid -  integer id as shorthand to refer to specific function definition
  * Function - function name
  * TimeFrame - tibble defining years and seasons the function applies to
  * Fleet - (optional) the fleet the function applies to
  * PopDims - tibble with population dimensions (less size, `z`) the function applies to
  * Label - characer string with underscores representing spaces to be used as a label

"Fleet" is an optional column in a Function table used to specify functions related to fisheries or surveys. 

#### Examples 

##### selectivity functions

```{text}
##--fishery selectivity functions
fid    Function      TimeFrame  Fleet    PopDims    Label
1    sel_logistic      tblYS1    TCF     tblPDs_M   TCF_male_selectivity_(start-1990)
2    sel_logistic      tblYS2    TCF     tblPDs_M   TCF_male_selectivity_(1991-2004)
3    sel_logistic      tblYS3    TCF     tblPDs_M   TCF_male_selectivity_(2005-end)
4    sel_logistic      tblYS1    TCF     tblPDs_F   TCF_female_selectivity_(start-1990)
5    sel_logistic      tblYS2    TCF     tblPDs_F   TCF_female_selectivity_(1991-2004)
6    sel_logistic      tblYS3    TCF     tblPDs_F   TCF_female_selectivity_(2005-end)
7    sel_dbl_normal    tblYS4    SCF     tblPDs_M   SCF_male_selectivity_(start-1996)
8    sel_logistic      tblYS4    SCF     tblPDs_F   SCF_female_selectivity_(start-1996)
```

##### retention functions

```{text}
##--fishery retention functions
fid    Function      TimeFrame  Fleet    PopDims    Label
1    sel_logistic      tblYS1    TCF     tblPDs_M   TCF_male_retention_(start-1990)
2    sel_logistic      tblYS2    TCF     tblPDs_M   TCF_male_retention_(1991-2004)
3    sel_logistic      tblYS3    TCF     tblPDs_M   TCF_male_retention_(2005-end)
```
